Value > 0 and !m_character->IsDead() (vtable +0x34): builds a Character::AttackResult, F_DotAttack(result, char, char, value, i), F_ApplyResult(result, char, char, false) (Character overload). The original's stack record is not initialised; the port zeroes it before F_DotAttack fills it. Depends on the Character F_ methods (other batches).

Walks the ItemInventory base of m_character (+0x37c) with qualified (non-virtual) ItemInventory calls. Per equipped slot: _LoadGearStats(itemId, leftHand), then _LoadGearPower(powerId, leftHand) for each power. Returns early when there are no slots. The original's unsigned return (slot count) is not part of the void header. Depends on _LoadGearStats and _LoadGearPower (other batch).
Sheet is s_temp when useTemp, otherwise m_props. Returns _GetProperty(sheet, id) >> 8 (arithmetic shift, as ASR #8).

Current faery id from Character::SG_GetCurrentFaerieId(-1). GetCharFaery returns an Arrays::FaeryTable row (stride 36) typed Structs::Faery, whose m_w2 (+0x8) is the property base. -1 gives 0. Otherwise the character's own CharProperties base (+0x560) reads its final sheet at id base+166.
Same faery lookup as PROPS_GetMagicDamageBonus with id base+159. -1 base gives 19200 (0x4b00). Otherwise the property plus 19200.

Equipment slot 2 when offHand, otherwise 1 (ItemInventory::GetEquippedItem, qualified). Item row (Structs::Item, +0x94 word m_w37, name not recovered) gives a property base; -1 or no item gives 0. Otherwise _GetProperty(m_props, base+64), raw value (no shift).
Same slot and item lookup as PROPS_GetBonusCritRating. Property base+51 is the attack rating. When IsDualWielding, property 58 is added to it. No item or base -1 gives 0.

Weapon damage bonus. Slot 1 (main hand) or 2 (off hand) of the inventory base of Character. Base property = Structs::Item m_w37 (+0x94 in the original) + 83, read from the final sheet. A two-hander adds property 91; dual wielding adds property 90. No item, or an item base of -1, returns 0.

Sheet word >> 8 (s_temp when useTemp, else m_props). Id 50 adds PROPS_GetBonusAttackRating(false) >> 8. Ids 79 and 80 add PROPS_GetBonusDamage(false) >> 8. Ids 81 and 82 add PROPS_GetBonusDamage(true) >> 8. Depends on PROPS_GetBonusAttackRating (0x3df81c, another batch).
True when the gear sheet, or any live buff instance in ascending class order, differs from _GetDefault. Values come from the _GetDefault stub until the default table is wired (partial, see 0x3def10).

Branch by the _GetType bits: 0x04 default then base, saved, gear added and every set buff added; 0x02 base, else saved, else gear, else first buff class (ascending keys, last set instance), else default; 0x01 buffs from the largest key down, else gear, saved, base, default; 0x20 base then saved added; 0x10 base; no bits leaves m_props as it is. Uses _AddProperty as decompiled (0x3df140). Branch choice depends on the _GetType stub (partial, see 0x3deed8), which returns 16 until the type table is wired.

Null sheet: level 2 aborts (the original stores through null), level 1 prints ASSERT(sheet) at CharProperties.cpp line 806, level 0 does nothing. Bit 0x04 stores the value in the given sheet, then RecalcProperty. Bit 0x08 stores it in m_props. Other types store nothing. The original returns the type in r0; the void header drops it.
Bit 0x20 adds to the saved sheet (wrapping 32-bit) then RecalcProperty. Bit 0x08 adds to m_props. Other types do nothing. The original's r0 result is dropped by the void header.
PROPS_Add(propId, value << 8). The shift is done on unsigned 32-bit values.
Bit 0x20 stores the value in the saved sheet, then RecalcProperty. Bit 0x08 stores it in m_props. Other types store nothing. The original's r0 result is dropped by the void header.
PROPS_Set(propId, value << 8). The shift is done on unsigned 32-bit values.

With reloadClass, _LoadClass(m_baseProps, class id, false) first. The class id is word m_w27 of the base sheet (CharProperties +0x74, read by the original as the class id). Then RecalcProperty for ids 0 to 223.
Stores the class id as int16 in Character::m_charPropsId (+0x13c8), then LoadBaseProperties(classId), then RecalcProperties(true). Depends on LoadBaseProperties (another batch).
ResetBaseProperties, LoadBaseProperties(charTableId), RecalcProperties(true).
ResetGearsProperties, LoadGearsProperties, RecalcProperties(true).

Original: destroys the m_insts deque (+0x20), then frees the string buffer of m_name (+0x08). The C++ body is empty: the implicit member destructors run in reverse declaration order, the same order. The BuffInst pointers are not freed here, as in the original.

Stops each live instance's timer (in ascending class order, then deque order), destroys it and frees it with CustomFree. Clears the class map, then RecalcProperties(true). PARTIAL: the original also calls VisualFXManager::DropAnimatedFX(&Singleton<VisualFXManager>::s_inst, &decl.m_fx) for each class. dh2/VisualFXManager.hpp does not exist yet, so that drop is not made.

Virtual slot 0 (complete-object destructor). Destroys each non-null live instance and frees it, clears each class deque, clears the map. The four sheets are destroyed after the body in reverse declaration order (m_buffs, m_props, m_gearProps, m_savedProps, m_baseProps), as the original does. PARTIAL: the per-class FX drop (VisualFXManager::DropAnimatedFX) is not made; dh2/VisualFXManager.hpp does not exist yet. The vptr is set by the compiler, as the original does first.

Virtual slot 1, deleting destructor. Compiler-generated for the C++ delete expression. The original body is ~CharProperties(this) then CustomFree(this). This build frees through the compiler's operator delete, not CustomFree.

Base-object destructor copy, not in the vtable. Same body as 0x3e0c6c; one definition in this file serves both addresses. PARTIAL for the same reason: the per-class FX drop (VisualFXManager::DropAnimatedFX) is not made; dh2/VisualFXManager.hpp does not exist yet.

Finds the class by id. A class with exactly one instance: that instance is stopped and freed and the class entry erased, whatever inst is. Otherwise inst must be in the class deque (else nothing): it is stopped, freed and erased from the deque. RecalcProperties(true) after either. PARTIAL: the one-instance path also calls VisualFXManager::DropAnimatedFX on the class FX pointer before the erase. dh2/VisualFXManager.hpp does not exist yet, so that drop is not made.

The timer's user data is the BuffInst. A timer id that differs from the instance's timer id is an assert (level 1 prints, level 2 aborts), then the instance is removed by PROPS_DelBuff(decl->m_id, inst). PARTIAL: a null timer asserts (level 1 prints, level 2 aborts) and then the original reads the timer's vtable through null and faults; the rebuild returns instead of faulting.

PARTIAL: the table open is not wired. The original opens PyData/character_properties_pystructnames.bin through the application file system (slot +0x90, declared nowhere; +0x88 is ApplicationOpenStream), and first calls DebugSwitches::load and GetSwitch('isTracingCharProperties') on DebugSwitches::s_inst (private in dh2/DebugSwitches.hpp; result unused). The stream is null, so the table stays empty. ReadPropNames (count, then length-prefixed names appended to s_propNames) is written and the stream is closed after reading; the original wraps the stream in a StreamBuffer and closes it before reading.
Loads the table when empty (LoadPropNames, partial), then returns the name for 0 <= propId < size, else nullptr (the original's 0).

Loads the table when empty, returns -1 for a null name or an empty table, else the index of the first name equal to name under ASCII case folding (the original's LC_API_STRCASECMP). Depends on LoadPropNames (partial), so it finds nothing until the open is wired.
Copies m_id, m_fx, m_name and m_insts. The deque holds BuffInst pointers, which are shared, not copied. The STLport string and deque internals are replaced by std::string and std::deque.
m_id -1, m_fx null, empty name and empty instance deque. The original's 16-byte string block and deque map set-up are the empty state of the standard containers.

PARTIAL: (1) the FX grab VisualFXManager::GrabAnimFX needs Singleton<VisualFXManager>::s_inst, which no header declares, so decl m_fx stays null. (2) The FX advance, AnimController slot +0x1c (PlayClip with size-1 and loop), is omitted: the original leaves its other two arguments unset at the call site. (3) CharTimers::TMR_TimeLeft leaves its out values unset for an inactive timer and the original then compares stack values; they are zeroed here. Reuse of an instance, level raise, creation, timer start with removal on failure, and the level in property 172 of the instance and of m_props are reproduced.

PARTIAL: the class id (index of AUTO_DOT_01_FIRE in Arrays::ClassTable names, plus element) and the FX id (same name in Arrays::AnimatedEffectTable names) need the name tables in pydata-accessors/member_names.hpp. That header declares the same structs as w7_arrays27.hpp, which holds the table data, and the two clash in one translation unit (checked). So no buff is added and nullptr is returned. The three ASSERT checks are reproduced. The original returns RecalcProperty's int (the m_props word) on success; the header declares a sheet pointer, so that value cannot be returned.

PARTIAL: the boss check and the zero-duration check are reproduced. The class Debuff_Slow and FX AUTO_DEBUFF_SLOW are found by name in the tables of pydata-accessors/member_names.hpp, which cannot be included with w7_arrays27.hpp (see PROPS_AddDot), so nothing is added after the checks.
Empty body, as in the original (a bare return). _LoadClass ends its walk after calling it for type 8.
Sets property fn.m_w1 (+4) to fn.m_w3 (+12).
Adds fn.m_w3 (+12) to property fn.m_w1 (+4), 32-bit wrapping.
Property fn.m_w1 becomes (sheet[fn.m_w3] * base) >> 8. base is sheet[fn.m_w1], or m_props[fn.m_w1] when useFinal is set. The product wraps as the 32-bit ARM MUL does.
Property fn.m_w1 becomes (sheet[fn.m_w3] * sheet[fn.m_w1]) >> 8. The binary does not read the bool argument (Hex-Rays shows three arguments), so useFinal is ignored.
Property fn.m_w1 becomes its value plus sheet[fn.m_w3], 32-bit wrapping.
Clamp of fn.m_w1 to the range fn.m_w3 (minimum) to fn.m_w4 (maximum), with the original's branch order.

Property fn.m_w1 becomes base + fn.m_w5 * (source >> 8). base is fn.m_w3, or the target's own value when fn.m_w3 is -666. source is property fn.m_w4. A non-final call on a sheet other than s_temp recalculates the source first. RecalcProperty returns the m_props word of the property it recalculated (checked on all its return paths), so the value is read from m_props after the call. Depends on RecalcProperty (batch 2), which is void in the owner header.

Walks the ClassFunc list of Arrays::ClassTable row classId (count m_w1, elements m_w2) and dispatches by fn.m_w2: 0 group, 1 linear, 2 min/max, 4 add property, 5 scale, 6 scale for buff then add value, 7 add value, 8 ApplyGroupOnlyIf and return (the rest of the list is not applied), 9 set. Other types do nothing. An out-of-range class id does nothing.
Loads the classes named by fn.m_w3, fn.m_w4 and fn.m_w5 in that order. A value of -1 names no class.

Adds the stats of Arrays::ItemTable row itemId (Structs::Item m_w22 type, m_w25, m_w35, m_w36) to m_gearProps. Types 0 and 3 pick the main-hand pair (81, 82) when leftHand is set, else the off-hand pair (79, 80). Types 4 and 5 add 79, 80 and 97 = m_w25 << 8. Types 6 and 7 to 0xC add their listed ids. No bounds check, as in the original.

Applies the effects of Arrays::ItemPowerTable row powerId (Structs::ItemPowerRef: m_w3 count, m_w4 elements of Structs::AttrBonusEntry with m_w1 type and m_w2 value) to m_gearProps. Type 9 sets, not adds, property 97 or 100. Types 7, 8, 0xA to 0x13 and 0x1C pick the left or right id. Types 0, 0x24 and 0x29 add several properties. Unknown types do nothing.
